failures.pattern: BLOCKING: 'npm test' (exit 1) failed, and no trustworthy base-commit baseline could be established (two base runs disagree (exit 1 then 1): the base is flaky). Treated as a regression. Fix it.
failures.root_cause: Three bash suites fail deterministically: sw-lib-test-gate-baseline-test (bun load-error, locked-acceptance and file-qualified duplicate-unit cases), sw-lib-pr-steward-test (the 'inspect may treat no checks as no CI' case, which expects '--no-checks-ok yes') and sw-lib-models-test. The failures follow the recent acceptance-locked and gate changes. Because the base commit fails the same suites, the gate cannot get a trustworthy baseline and treats the run as a regression.
failures.fix: Fix tg_parse_log and the baseline comparison in scripts/lib/test-gate-baseline.sh so bun units are file-qualified and a locked acceptance test blocks even when the base fails it. Make pr-steward pass --no-checks-ok yes to inspect. Fix the sw-lib-models-test failure. Re-run the three suites with `bash scripts/sw-test-all.sh --pattern <re>` until each passes twice in a row.
